title: tax.policy.snapshot — Payload Schema
description: Full snapshot of all active tax policies exported by erp.tax-engine. This contract exports policy definitions — not calculations. commerce.engine applies the policy to compute the tax amount at checkout time. A new snapshot is published whenever any policy changes. Pending ADR-005: whether Commerce estimates the tax at checkout or defers final computation to ERP.

policies.description: Full set of tax policies active from effective_from onwards. Replaces the previous snapshot entirely.

id.description: Stable policy identifier. Referenced in order line items as policy_id.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Supported: CL, MX, US, AR, UY, BR, PE, VE.

region.description: State or region code. Required for US SalesTax where rates vary by jurisdiction. Null for country-wide policies.

tax_type.description: IVA: Chile (19%). IGV: Peru (18%). SalesTax: USA (varies by state/city). Exempt: no tax applied.

rate.description: Tax rate as a decimal fraction. Examples: 0.19 = 19%, 0.18 = 18%, 0 = Exempt.

applies_to.description: Item categories subject to this policy. Chile taxes parts only. Peru taxes all.

rounding.description: Rounding rule applied to the computed tax amount. Must match the rounding used in ERP fiscal documents.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this policy's country.

effective_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. All policies in this snapshot are valid from this date onwards. Consumers must not apply this snapshot before effective_from.
